$comment: Performance budgets CI holds the app to (TA-35). Raise one only on purpose, in the same pull request as the change that needs it, and say why there.

bundle.$comment: Gzipped bytes of each Vite entry in public/build/manifest.json, and of all of them together. Measured 2026-11-24: app.css 42,571, passkeys.js 3,895, app.js 20.

load.$comment: k6 against the full Docker stack (proxy, two production-like app nodes), 25 virtual users (TA-31's load test used 25 concurrent) for 30 s per scenario. Each scenario must stay under its p95_ms, average at least its rps over its 30 s, and fail no request. Measured 2026-11-24 on Docker Desktop (Windows): central homepage 161 req/s p95 202 ms, agency homepage 152 req/s p95 215 ms, signed-in dashboard 119 req/s p95 279 ms. A run also fails when a scenario is more than regression_margin worse than main's last run.

lighthouse.$comment: Lowest category scores, 0 to 1, on every page lighthouserc.json lists.
